items.q: R10 000 grows at 6% per year, compounded annually. What is its value after 2 years?
items.qAf: R10 000 groei teen 6% per jaar, jaarliks saamgestel. Wat is die waarde na 2 jaar?

items.q: What is the decay factor for a 25% decrease?
items.qAf: Wat is die vervalfaktor vir ’n afname van 25%?
items.explain: A 25% decrease leaves 75%, so the factor is 0,75.
items.explainAf: ’n Afname van 25% laat 75%, dus is die faktor 0,75.

items.q: A value that decreases by a fixed percentage each year is modelled by:
items.qAf: ’n Waarde wat elke jaar met ’n vaste persentasie afneem, word gemodelleer deur:
items.explain: Repeated multiplication by a constant factor below 1 gives exponential decay.
items.explainAf: Herhaalde vermenigvuldiging met ’n konstante faktor onder 1 gee eksponensiële verval.

items.q: A car costs R200 000 and depreciates by R20 000 per year (straight line). What is its value after 3 years?
items.qAf: ’n Motor kos R200 000 en verminder R20 000 per jaar (reguitlyn). Wat is sy waarde na 3 jaar?

items.q: R100 000 depreciates by 10% per year on the reducing balance. What is its value after 2 years?
items.qAf: R100 000 verminder met 10% per jaar op die afnemende saldo. Wat is sy waarde na 2 jaar?

items.q: Which method gives equal decreases in value each year?
items.qAf: Watter metode gee gelyke afnames in waarde elke jaar?
items.explain: Straight-line depreciation subtracts the same amount each year.
items.explainAf: Reguitlyn-waardevermindering trek elke jaar dieselfde bedrag af.
